name: churn-early-warning
description: Ranks which paying customers might churn, on request: it reads your payments data for cancellations, scheduled cancellations, downgrades, seat cuts, past-due and repeatedly failed payments, trials ending and renewals in the next 30 days (7 to 90 if you ask) over changes in the last 30 days (7 to 60), then checks your email (and a support desk, if connected) for a recent complaint quoted word for word or a customer gone quiet. Every MRR value, date and risk score is computed in code; each account shows its evidence and a suggested outreach (save call, win-back, billing help, renewal check-in...). It ranks risk, it never says a customer will churn, and it never changes a subscription. On request it drafts an outreach email and sends it only after you approve that exact text, one draft at a time. No payments connection? Paste rows of account, email, mrr, renewal_date, status, changed_at, change.

skills.name: Churn early warning
skills.description: Accounts at risk of churning in the next 30 days (7-90), ranked by a transparent score from billing signals, verbatim email complaints, silence and support tickets, with MRR, evidence and a suggested outreach. Then an outreach email per account, sent only after you approve the exact text.
examples: Which renewals in the next 14 days look risky?
Draft outreach for the top two
